notes: Metres, Z up, robot front -X, shared bottom-centre frame; applied transforms. CPU Cycles 64 diffuse colour times mix(1, AO, 0.6); PBR source retained. Inspection render 1024 square; preview thumbnail 512 for the unchanged validator. Four shallow screw wells and screw slots are visual; prescribed single box collision bridges them. Task 13 compact OBJ exception: positions use 5 decimal metres where safe; necessary vertices retain up to 6 decimals to preserve nonzero triangles, strict collision convexity and the 0.005 mm Euclidean movement bound. Independent fixed-5 rounding cannot satisfy all three. Normals/UVs use 4 decimals; every original triangle, position index and per-corner attribute value is retained. Equal rounded UV records share indices and visual OBJ indices use shorter equivalent relative notation. No collision remeshing, reindexing or simplification.
